newsitem.title: USA: Arrow to acquire Premier Farnell business.
newsitem.headline: Arrow to acquire Premier Farnell business.

text.p: Arrow Electronics Inc. said Friday it agreed to acquire Farnell Electronic Services, the volume electronic component distribution business of Britain's Premier Farnell Plc, for about $300 million.
Arrow is a distributor of electronic components and computer products to industrial and commercial customers.

With annual sales of about $500 million and operations in 15 countries, the Farnell Electronic Services group is one of Europe's leading distributors of semiconductors, passive and electromechanical components, and interconnect products to original equipment manufacturers and other industrial customers.

Under another agreement, Melville, N.Y., Arrow will become a preferred supplier to Premier Farnell's remaining core catalogue business. Similarly, Arrow will be able to source certain of its product requirements from Premier Farnell.
The purchase is expected to be completed before the end of March.
Arrow stock was down 12.5 cents at $51.625 at midday on the New York Stock Exchange.
